messages:
sam: Quick flag — canary rollout v3 (model:v3-quant-fallback) shows ~12% increase in P95 token latency on /chat/conv-route versus v2. Noticed during the 9:20 canary window. :eyes:

lenore: link?

sam: https://internal.grafana/redwood/d/abc123/model-compare?v=canary
PromQL snippet:
```
sum by (route) (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model_version)))
```

cheng: @sam saw elevated KV miss rate for the same window — hit-rate dropped from 98.7% -> 92.1%. Could explain extra kv_lookup time + kernel fallback.

tay: do we have token-phase breakdown in dashboards? need kv_lookup, kernel_select, kernel_exec, softmax, send-back.

sam: Not yet per-route. Current panels show aggregate token latency slices, but not per-model per-route. I captured a flame trace: kernel selection spiking to fallback_cuda_quant at T+12s when sequence>512.

sam:
```
# proposed metrics
runtime_kernel_selector_total{route,model_version,kernel}  # counter
token_phase_seconds_bucket{phase="kv_lookup|kernel_exec|decode"}
```

lenore: Can infra add counters to router and runtime to label why kernel changed? (quant-quality-fallback, seq_len_cutoff, hardware_unavailable)

infra-bot: deploy v3-canary started by @sam at 2026-03-17T09:19:45Z (build 2026.03.17.9). Canary = 5% traffic.

tay: plan — add per-route kernel_select counter + dashboard panels; add per-route P95 token-slice bars; run A/B with traffic split 50/50 after fix. Also add alert: token_slice_p95_delta > 5% for 10m.

cheng: I'll instrument KV metrics and add KV latency breakdown. Will push a hotfix to cache prefetch heuristics (reduce eviction on long-tail requests).

sam: Great. Add regression runbook note in the dashboard: roll back to v2 if token_slice_p95 delta > 8% and error_rate increase > 0.5%.

lenore: +1 — assign owner: @cheng for KV, @tay for dashboards, @sam for canary orchestration.

deploy-bot: canary traffic increased to 20% at 2026-03-17T09:45:00Z by @sam. No errors reported so far.

sam: keeping this thread for notes; will post final A/B results here once 24h window completes.
